criteria.criterion: no blocking findings (no example, synthetic or missing input)
no unconfirmed values saved before source tracking
at least one meter export declared real, with no plausibility warning
a billing period reconciles with the real bill (selected tariff, that meter export)
no experiment on example inputs remains in use
an experiment created from the confirmed inputs

limits: WATTWISE records where each value comes from; it cannot prove that a file or a typed value is genuine.
A document retrieved by WATTWISE shows which document a value was taken from, not that it was copied correctly.
Meter files are checked for implausible patterns only; a careful forgery would pass.
